title: Streamlining what universities offer could backfire for disadvantaged students

sentences: The government's vision for higher education in England, set out in a recent policy paper, includes some changes that will benefit students from poorer backgrounds.
translations: 政府在最近一份政策文件中提出的英格兰高等教育愿景，包括一些将使贫困背景学生受益的变化。

sentences: An increase in maintenance loans, for instance, will help to support disadvantaged students.
So too will the introduction of a lifelong learning entitlement loan.
Students from disadvantaged backgrounds often have learning trajectories that are far from linear, so access to a lifetime entitlement makes sense.
translations: 例如，增加生活补助贷款将有助于支持弱势学生。
引入终身学习权利贷款也将起到同样的作用。
来自弱势背景的学生往往拥有远非线性的学习轨迹，因此获得终身学习权利是合理的。

sentences: Other positive aspects include an aim to create more joined-up thinking in communities, greater links between higher education providers and employers and targeted funding initiatives.
There is a general acknowledgement of the challenges disadvantaged students face.
And these students are addressed throughout the document, albeit mostly through the lens of seeing their economic potential.
translations: 其他积极方面包括旨在促进社区内更协同的思维、加强高等教育机构与雇主之间的联系，以及有针对性的资助计划。
人们普遍承认弱势学生所面临的挑战。
这些学生在整个文件中都被提及，尽管主要是从挖掘其经济潜力的角度出发。

sentences: But the government's broader strategy for universities will present significant challenges for students who come from poorer families and live in disadvantaged areas.
It encourages universities to carve out particular specialisms.
This means honing their expertise and concentrating on their unique selling point – their "core purpose".
It suggests that while competition can be healthy, "too many providers with similar offerings are chasing the same students".
translations: 但政府对大学的更广泛战略将给来自贫困家庭和生活在不利地区的学生带来重大挑战。
它鼓励大学开辟特定的专业领域。
这意味着磨练他们的专长，并专注于其独特的卖点——他们的“核心宗旨”。
它表明，虽然竞争可能是健康的，但“太多提供类似课程的机构在争夺相同的学生”。

sentences: The implications for this in practice may be that universities axe some of their courses in favour of a narrower menu of study.
The casualties of such a move would typically be arts and humanities courses.
This is especially likely when the government plans to offer funding incentives for priority areas, which include science, technology and engineering.
translations: 这在实践中的影响可能是，大学会砍掉一些课程，转而提供更狭窄的学习菜单。
这一举措的牺牲品通常是艺术和人文学科课程。
当政府计划为重点领域（包括科学、技术和工程）提供资金激励时，这种情况尤其可能发生。

sentences: Indeed, many reductions in the higher education portfolio have already taken place across the sector, such as for arts subjects.
This is arguably due to pressures on each university to deliver "successful outcomes" for its students.
These outcomes, such as employment after graduation, however, are narrowly measured.
They run the risk of devaluing arts-based education.
They also may constrain opportunities for many people seeking greater life chances.
translations: 事实上，高等教育领域的许多课程削减已经发生，例如艺术类学科。
这可以说是因为每所大学都面临压力，需要为学生提供“成功的结果”。
然而，这些结果（如毕业后的就业情况）的衡量标准过于狭隘。
它们有可能贬低艺术教育的价值。
它们还可能限制许多寻求更好生活机会的人的发展机遇。

sentences: Disadvantaged students in particular could be significantly affected by changes that reduce the variety of courses available at their local university.
A diverse portfolio of courses creates opportunities for those who may not traditionally access higher education.
Disadvantaged students are less likely to apply to prestigious institutions.
They are more likely to study closer to home.
translations: 特别是弱势学生，可能会受到减少当地大学课程种类变化的显著影响。
多样化的课程组合为那些传统上可能无法接受高等教育的人创造了机会。
弱势学生申请名校的可能性较小。
他们更倾向于在离家较近的地方学习。

sentences: In recent years, closure of courses at universities has created what is known as cold spots.
These are areas of the UK where certain university subjects are not offered.
These closures, unfortunately, often affect lower tariff providers – universities that require lower grades for entry to a degree course.
This means reduced opportunities for disadvantaged students to access the courses they might want to study in their local area.
translations: 近年来，大学课程的关闭造成了所谓的冷点区域。
这些是英国某些大学学科未被提供的地区。
不幸的是，这些关闭通常影响低门槛院校——即对学位课程入学要求较低成绩的大学。
这意味着弱势学生在其当地学习他们可能想学的课程的机会减少了。

sentences: For regional areas, too, a wealth of course availability can create wider opportunities.
For instance, it can allow local businesses to make use of a wide range of skills from students who remain in the area.
translations: 对于地区而言，丰富的课程选择也能创造更广阔的机会。
例如，这能让当地企业利用留在该地区的学生所拥有的各种技能。

sentences: Streamlining what universities offer may also result in further status distinctions between higher education institutions.
It could pave the way for an even more ferociously competitive sector, the rationale being that "the cream will rise to the top."
But this may mean that only universities ranking highly in a particular field will be positioned to provide courses in this field.
translations: 精简大学提供的课程也可能导致高等教育机构之间进一步的地位分化。
这可能为一个竞争更加激烈的领域铺平道路，其理由是“优胜劣汰”。
但这可能意味着，只有在一个特定领域排名靠前的大学才有能力提供该领域的课程。

sentences: This is neglectful of smaller and often newer providers that may be in need of developmental support.
It may close down opportunities for universities to grow and establish research excellence where it may not yet exist.
translations: 这忽视了那些规模较小且通常较新、可能需要发展支持的提供者。
这可能会关闭大学在尚未具备研究卓越性的领域成长和建立卓越研究的机会。

sentences: It benefits everyone if England's higher education system grows and flourishes.
But for every positive choice we make, we have to consider the possible fallout on marginalised members of society.
The implementation of these policy proposals, then, will need to consider the implications of perpetuating a heavily driven and economically competitive market for higher education.
This could mean careful contemplation of the purpose of higher education itself.
translations: 如果英格兰的高等教育体系能够发展壮大，这对每个人都有好处。
但每当我们做出积极的选择时，都必须考虑可能对社会边缘群体造成的影响。
因此，这些政策提案的实施需要考虑维持一个高度驱动且经济竞争激烈的高等教育市场所带来的影响。
这可能意味着需要仔细思考高等教育本身的目的。
